hooks.prompt: Check if the stop_hook_active field is true in the input. If it is, respond with {"ok": true}. Otherwise, look at the conversation context. Were any significant code changes made (new features, bug fixes, refactors, data model changes)? If yes, respond with {"ok": false, "reason": "Session produced code changes. Summarize what was built or changed to the user and ask if they want to update docs/app-updates.md with a new changelog entry and bump the version."}. If the session was only discussion or planning with no code written, respond with {"ok": true}.
